responses._comment: SLG-117: the title graph's (svelte_langgraph.title.make_title_graph) prompt for the single-exchange conversation sidebar.spec.ts creates by sending 'Testing automatic thread titles for SLG-117' (echoed back verbatim as the assistant reply by mockai's unmatched-input fallback, so both User: and Assistant: lines in the rendered conversation carry that same text -- see _render_conversation_for_title in apps/backend/src/svelte_langgraph/title.py). Derived programmatically, not hand-typed, by running (in the backend venv, from apps/backend/): `python3 -c "from langchain_core.messages import HumanMessage, AIMessage; from svelte_langgraph.title import TITLE_PROMPT, _render_conversation_for_title; msg = 'Testing automatic thread titles for SLG-117'; print(TITLE_PROMPT.format(conversation=_render_conversation_for_title([HumanMessage(msg), AIMessage(msg)])))"`. mockai matches on exact string equality, so any change to title.py's TITLE_PROMPT, the rendering, or the trigger message must update this entry too.
